title.en: Chapter 24 — Too Late by One Day

book_meta.author: Arthur Conan Doyle
book_meta.status: public domain — all Holmes entered the US public domain by 2023

sentences.en: Holmes examined the room.
Cubitt lay on the floor, the bullet in his heart.

sentences.ar: وإلسي فوق، بين إيدين الدكتور، والرصاصة براسها.
sentences.en: And Elsie upstairs, in the doctor's hands, the bullet in her head.
And Holmes looked at the window.
And said: the window is shut.
But look at the frame.
In the wood, at the edge, a bullet hole.
He said: three shots, not two.

sentences.ar: وحدة من جوا لبرا، ووحدة من برا لجوا.
sentences.en: One from inside out, and one from outside in.

sentences.ar: في واحد تالت، كان واقف عالشباك.
sentences.en: There was a third person, standing at the window.

sentences.ar: والشباك كان مفتوح، وبعدين حدا سكره.
sentences.en: And the window was open, and then someone shut it.
Who?
Elsie.
Before she shot herself.

sentences.ar: وبالحديقة، تحت الشباك، أثر جزمة كبيرة، وفارغ رصاصة.
sentences.en: And in the garden, under the window, the print of a big boot, and a cartridge case.

sentences.ar: وبالطريق، الخادمة قالت: بالليل، شميت ريحة بارود بالممر.
sentences.en: And on the way, the maid said: at night, I smelled powder in the corridor.

sentences.ar: قال هولمز: ريحة بارود بالممر، والباب مقفول، يعني الشباك كان مفتوح.
sentences.en: Holmes said: powder in the corridor, with the door locked, means the window was open.
And the wind carried it.

sentences.ar: وقعد هولمز عالطاولة، وكتب على ورقة رجال زغار بيرقصوا.
sentences.en: And Holmes sat at the table, and wrote on a paper little dancing men.
And gave it to the stable boy.

sentences.ar: وقال: خدها لمزرعة إلريج، وأعطيها للأمريكي، وارجع.
sentences.en: And said: take this to Elrige's farm, give it to the American, and come back.
The inspector said: what did you write?
Holmes said: an invitation.

sentences.ar: وقال: يا سادة، خلوا مسدساتكم جاهزة، واقعدوا ورا الباب.
sentences.en: And said: gentlemen, have your revolvers ready, and sit behind the door.
And half an hour later, he came.

sentences.ar: رجل طويل، أسمر، ملامحه حادة، وقبعة عريضة.
sentences.en: A tall man, dark, with sharp features, a broad hat.
Walking through the garden like the master of the house.

sentences.ar: ودق الباب، وفتحنا، ونطينا عليه، ولبسناه الكلبشات قبل ما يفهم.
sentences.en: And knocked at the door, and we opened, leapt on him, and had him in handcuffs before he understood.
And he looked at us, and said: who are you?
Where is Elsie?
She sent for me.

sentences.ar: قال هولمز: إلسي بين الحياة والموت.
sentences.en: Holmes said: Elsie is between life and death.
And I am the one who sent for you.

sentences.ar: وطلع الورقة، وفرجاه ياها: COME HERE AT ONCE.
sentences.en: And took out the paper, and showed him: come here at once.
Slaney said: you?
And you can write it?
No one outside the gang knows it!

sentences.ar: قال هولمز: اللي بيخترعه إنسان، بيفكه إنسان.
sentences.en: Holmes said: what one man invents, another can unravel.

sentences.ar: وسلاني قعد، ووجهه صار أبيض، وحكى.
sentences.en: And Slaney sat, his face gone white, and told.
He said: Elsie was my fiancée, in Chicago.

sentences.ar: وأبوها رئيس العصابة، واللي اخترع الشفرة.
sentences.en: And her father the head of the gang, and the one who invented the cipher.

sentences.ar: وهي كرهت الشغل، وهربت، وتزوجت هالإنجليزي.
sentences.en: And she hated the business, and ran, and married this Englishman.

sentences.ar: وأنا لحقتها، وكتبت لها، وكانت ترد: ارجع.
sentences.en: And I followed her, and wrote to her, and she answered: go back.
I do not love you.

sentences.ar: ومبارح بالليل، إجت عالشباك، وعرضت عليّ مصاري عشان أروح.
sentences.en: And last night, she came to the window, and offered me money to go.

sentences.ar: وجنيت، ومديت إيدي أسحبها من الشباك، وزوجها دخل بمسدسه.
sentences.en: And I went mad, and reached to drag her through the window, and her husband came in with his revolver.

sentences.ar: وطخ عليّ، وطخيت عليه، بنفس اللحظة.
sentences.en: And he fired at me, and I fired at him, in the same instant.
And I ran.

sentences.ar: وما عرفت إنها طخت حالها لحد هلق.
sentences.en: And I did not know she had shot herself until now.

sentences.ar: وحطوه بالسجن، وعاشت إلسي، وقضت حياتها بتساعد الفقرا، وما تزوجت.
sentences.en: And they put him in prison, and Elsie lived, and spent her life helping the poor, and never remarried.

sentences.ar: وقال هولمز بالقطار: تأخرنا يوم يا واطسون.
sentences.en: And Holmes said on the train: we were a day late, Watson.
And cleverness does not bring back time.
